title: I made a cozy FPS where you SHOOT AT EVERYTHING AND DECAPITATE ALIENS AND ANGELS (TIME SHREDDERS - full game)
author: gun2000
selftext:
Play on [https://magiadev.ovh/ts/](https://magiadev.ovh/ts/)

**What’s in it:** 8 missions across time (1953 Naples mafia, Maya jungle, Siberian base, Neo Hong Kong 2337, the Cretaceous, the Alps, medieval France, Hell → Heaven), ragdoll physics, kicks and slide-kicks, enemy pathfinding with different “intelligence” levels, an arcade challenge league, and a hub where you meet your characters.

**How it was made:** I put in all my ideas of what a ***fun*** FPS should be (bullet time, big kicks, skill shots, EXPLOSIONS). It took **100 published versions** to get here. I started with one level in 1953 Naples and a pizza launcher, then kept iterating with Claude Opus 5.5 with Babylon.js which is in fact far less popular than Three.js.

replies.author: gun2000
replies.body: The Mayan village is pretty cozy if you don't kill anyone

comments.body: What does cozy mean to you? Genuinely asking

replies.author: gun2000
replies.body: Just a joke because cozy games are very popular haha

comments.author: DraconicBlade
comments.body:
The good: You got the guns to line up with there the bullets are. Honestly a step above most of the trash clips on here.

The bad: everything else. Holy shit this makes cruelty squad seem readable. The starting town is alright, and then everything gets a yellow wash in the next scene, and then it just gets worse. Cannot tell what the fuck is going on, where enemies are, what the floor is, how far the walls are. It's fucked m8.

And the voxel edge transparency wireframes are horrendous.

And you're like, chest high at best. are you supposed to be oddjob? how did you not raise the y axis on the camera in 100 versions?

replies.author: gun2000
replies.body: Thank you, very helpful comment. When you playtest the same thing in a loop, some obvious problems start to disappear.

replies.author: DraconicBlade
replies.body: The pop art city is particularly bad, maybe it's the way your lighting is baked but all I track are purple squares
